fact_text: Lucky Cement reported Q3 FY26 earnings per share of 13.02, down 15.7% quarter on quarter and up 6.3% year on year, with no dividend declared for the quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's nine-month FY26 earnings per share were 43.47, up 10.9% year on year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's Q3 FY26 net sales were about 130.2 billion PKR, up 5% quarter on quarter, while gross profit was about 30 billion PKR, down 2% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's Q3 FY26 other income was 3.38 billion PKR, down 57% quarter on quarter; the reporter said total other income was about 8.3 billion, of which 6.1 billion came from Lucky Electric Power.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said Lucky Cement's quarterly earnings are flattered by an unusual Lucky Electric dividend, which Lucky Electric paid twice in FY26 rather than once a year; without it, underlying earnings would be roughly flat sequentially.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said Lucky Cement's consolidated gross margin fell quarter on quarter, mainly due to lower margins at Lucky Motor and the foreign cement operations in Africa and Iraq.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: At a share price of about 400-405 PKR, the analyst said Lucky Cement traded at roughly 6 to 7 times the estimated full-year earnings, which he called a decent multiple.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's cash balance was about 66 PKR per share, which the analyst said gave management room for new projects and kept dividends on the lower side.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said the cement business contributes about 35-40% of Lucky Cement's earnings, with the rest coming from Lucky Electric Power, Lucky Motor and other subsidiaries.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said cement demand fell for about five years despite spare capacity, and that 2026 could be the first year in five with positive offtake, with growth of about 10-11% expected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Cement capacity utilisation in the North is about 50-50% in the analyst's description, while Southern players run higher because of better exports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said cement makers have been able to pass cost and inflation pressures on to consumers because demand is stable, but a rise in coal prices could squeeze margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The Federal Constitutional Court struck down section 7E of the Income Tax Ordinance as ultra vires, which the analyst said could lift real estate and construction activity and help cement demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said interest rates had risen somewhat, could rise further on high refinery pressures and oil prices, and that a monetary tightening could reduce cement volumes if the policy rate tightens further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst noted that cement offtake in April 2026 improved month on month, and expected the June 2026 quarter to be relatively better, with coal prices as the main risk to margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Al-Ghazi Tractors reported Q1 CY26 earnings per share of 11.69, down 56.86% quarter on quarter, and the reporter said it was many times higher than the year-earlier quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Al-Ghazi Tractors' Q1 CY26 net sales were about 7 billion PKR, down 33.8% quarter on quarter, with gross profit of about 1.9 billion (down 44.68%) and operating expenses of about 1.1 billion (down 56.3%).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Al-Ghazi Tractors' sales volumes fell 27% in the March 2026 quarter compared with the December quarter, mainly because the December quarter had been aggressive on volumes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Al-Ghazi Tractors' gross margin was about 27% in the March 2026 quarter, down from about 32% in the prior quarter, though it had improved from about 18-19% two years earlier on better volumes and economies of scale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said Al-Ghazi Tractors has not paid a dividend since 2021, though it earned well in 2024 at about 60 per share and has the capacity to pay; a dividend could return depending on management's stance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: At an annual briefing, Al-Ghazi Tractors' management gave aggressive targets, with a net revenue target of about 32 billion PKR, against net sales of about 32-34 billion in 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst assumed Al-Ghazi Tractors could earn about 50 per share in a full year, and said the stock's multiple would be around 7 times that level; the Punjab green tractor subsidy shifting to high-horsepower models was cited as a volume driver.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum reported Q3 FY26 earnings per share of 67, up about 29% quarter on quarter and about 24% year on year, with net sales of about 129 billion PKR, up 5% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum's gross profit was about 1.4 billion PKR, up 22% quarter on quarter, and income tax expense was about 5.4 billion, up 28% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum booked an inventory gain of about 10 billion PKR in Q3 FY26; excluding it, quarterly earnings were about 24 per share against about 20 in the prior quarter, with gross margin near 12% versus 3.9% earlier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst put Attock Petroleum's recurring annual earnings at about 80 per share, implying a 50% payout with a 40 final dividend, and said a 6-7 times multiple on that base would be the basis for valuation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: A Goldman Sachs report, cited by the reporter, expects oil futures near 85 USD per barrel by December 2026, which could bring inventory losses for oil marketing companies, though inventory gains and losses are cyclical.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)

fact_text: The analyst said investors should look at an oil marketing company's recurring earnings rather than inventory gains, and should check trade debts, cash collection, market share and the volume growth of diesel and petrol.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of LUCK, AGTL, and APL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-20)
